components.name: Asset Card on the Stage
components.description: The frameless card: an 18% grey stage with a floor shadow, a type chip, the name and mono facts.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 140px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #e9e9e6; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Geist', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stage { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 90% at 50% 30%, #7e7e7e, #767676 55%, #6c6c6c); transition: box-shadow 0.12s; } .ds-stage::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 18%; right: 18%; bottom: 13%; height: 9%; background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(0,0,0,0.4), transparent); } .ds-card:hover .ds-stage { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #1f1f20, 0 0 0 2px #94948f; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-card:focus-visible .ds-stage, .ds-card[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-stage { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1f1f20, 0 0 0 4px #e9e9e6; } .ds-type { position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 6px 0 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(31,31,32,0.88); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 18px; } .ds-type i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-name { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-fact { font: 400 11px 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #a3a3a0; }

narrative.overview:
Asset Hub is a look-dev bench, not a showroom. Every thumbnail and viewer sits on the same true 18% grey stage with a soft floor shadow. An asset is judged in the same light wherever it appears. A graphite shell frames that stage and stays quiet: three close greys for ground, panel and raised surfaces, hairline borders, and warm off-white text. The calibration tools of a lighting artist are the visual source: the grey ball, the chrome ball and the colour checker.

Colour carries meaning only. The colour checker's orange patch marks the one primary action on a surface. The other checker patches mark asset types, as small swatches on chips and sidebar rows. Green, yellow and red mark state. Nothing else is coloured. The density is high and steady: a 48px top bar, a 232px sidebar, 28px rows, a grid of small cells (120px or 180px minimum) and a 380px inspector. People scan hundreds of assets at once and read the facts that decide.

The system rejects the dark-panel asset grid with huge cards, a neon accent, and decoration that carries no information. It also replaces the 2.0 look (gunmetal, amber accent, Chakra Petch display face, chest logo) in full.
keyCharacteristics: One calibrated stage (18% grey) under every preview, cards and viewers alike.
Graphite shell in three tonal steps, separated by 1px hairlines, not by shadow.
One orange for the primary action. Colour-checker patches for asset types. Green, yellow and red for state.
Geist for words, Geist Mono for figures and paths, four fixed size steps.
Dense, keyboard-first rows at 28px. Quiet until hovered or pressed.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Checker Orange is the fill of the single primary action on a surface. It is not a highlight, a selection colour or a pressed state. Selection and pressed states use Paper White, Graphite Raise and Ground.

rules.name: The Colour Means Something Rule
rules.body: Outside the primary action and state, colour comes only from the colour-checker type patches, and only as a small swatch. A coloured surface, border or text that names no type and no state is a defect.

rules.name: The Same Light Rule
rules.body: Every preview of an asset sits on Stage Grey. A dark backdrop is a viewer option the user picks, never a default.

rules.name: The Four Steps Rule
rules.body: Text uses exactly four sizes: 11, 12, 13 and 16px (`--fs-xs` to `--fs-lg`). There is no display size. Hierarchy comes from weight (400, 500, 600) and from colour (Paper White to Dim Grey), not from new sizes.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for figures and machine strings: sizes, counts, times, versions, file paths and typed paths. Prose never takes the mono face. A path field whose empty hint is a sentence shows the hint in Geist.

rules.name: The Dense Bench Rule
rules.body: Rows are 28px and cells start at 120px. Do not add height or padding to make a surface "breathe". The density is the product.

rules.name: The Flat Shell Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the shell casts a shadow at rest. A shadow means "this floats over the app" or "this is the asset's floor".

dos: **Do** put every asset preview on Stage Grey (#767676) with the soft floor shadow, in cards and viewers alike.
**Do** give each surface one orange primary action, with Burnt Umber Ink text on it.
**Do** mark asset types only with the colour-checker patch as a small square swatch, and keep the type word in text colour.
**Do** use the four sizes (11, 12, 13, 16px) and build hierarchy from weight and text colour.
**Do** set sizes, counts, times, versions and paths in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
**Do** separate shell regions with 1px hairlines and tonal steps. Keep shadows for floating panels.
**Do** show focus as a 2px Paper White outline on every interactive element.
donts: **Don't** use orange for selection, pressed, favourite or "on" states. Use Paper White, Raise and Ground.
**Don't** colour a surface, border or text with a type patch. The patch is a swatch, not a theme.
**Don't** add a display size, a fifth text size or a remote font.
**Don't** draw the 3D floor grid into a captured thumbnail.
**Don't** default a preview to a dark or coloured backdrop. Stage Grey is the default, and a dark backdrop is the user's choice.
**Don't** use the danger red for a normal choice such as signing out.
**Don't** add decoration that carries no information: no gradients on the shell, no glow, no neon accent, no large showroom cards.
